Graduate Program English Requirements
Admissions
All graduate applicants must obtain a minimum TOEFL-IBT score of 71 (We are currently accepting TOEFL scores with the new range (1-6) but will continue to assess proficiency using the comparable overall score (0-120)) -or- a minimum IELTS score of 6.0 -or- a minimum PTE score of 48 -or- a minimum DET score of 100 for full-time academic admission, with the many exceptions for individual graduate programs:
